evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This discovery capability does not clearly depend on a missing complementary CRUD capability elsewhere in the backlog (e.g., it can operate on an existing catalog). No explicit prerequisite story is evidenced as absent.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires existence of a user profile and profile management (create/update) to be usable, but the backlog contains no story to create/manage user profiles.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity-based discovery presupposes user profiles and/or user preference data. No complementary story exists for creating/maintaining profiles or collecting preference signals.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Operates on a provided input item ('a given music video'); no missing complementary capability is clearly implied by the backlog (the input could be an existing item).

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: While it relies on metadata/tags, the backlog includes a story to upload tagged videos (ZO-006) and multiple admin tagging/annotation stories; no obvious missing complementary capability is evidenced as absent.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation/ingestion capability that other processing and discovery stories can build on; no complementary prerequisite is clearly missing.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing 'video segments' implies segmentation exists. The backlog has admin validation/edit of segmentation (ZO-019) but no story to create/perform initial segmentation, leaving a crucial complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Depends on existence of segments and similarity computation. Segments lack an explicit creation story (only validate/edit exists in ZO-019), indicating a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Like ZO-008, it presupposes segment availability; backlog lacks a story for generating segmentation (only validation/edit in ZO-019).

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations from 'similar profiles' require user profiles and preference data creation/maintenance, which is not covered by any story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Requires determining the user's area/location and ingesting/maintaining 'news events' data. No complementary story exists for capturing user location/preferences or sourcing/maintaining news events.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: This can be implemented as an analysis feature over existing videos; no explicit missing complementary CRUD capability is evidenced by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Does not clearly expose a missing complementary capability in the backlog; can operate on ingested videos.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Analysis over existing videos; no necessary complementary capability is clearly absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Analysis over existing videos; no explicit missing prerequisite story is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Includes its own creation step (take/upload image) and recommendation outcome; does not rely on an obviously missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Requires geotagging/associating videos with locations and map/location services. The backlog lacks a complementary story to capture/store location metadata for videos or manage POIs/coverage data.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a search feature over existing content; no explicit missing complementary CRUD capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Validation/editing presupposes segmentation exists. No story covers generating/creating the initial segmentation, leaving a crucial complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation can be performed by admins; while it depends on segments, that gap is already evidenced by segmentation stories (ZO-019/ZO-007). This story itself does not uniquely expose an additional missing complementary capability beyond that set-level gap.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking can operate on existing ingested videos; no missing complementary CRUD capability is clearly implied.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Assessment can be performed on uploaded audio/video; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering is a standalone moderation capability over ingested content; no missing complementary CRUD capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Search/prefilter can operate on ingested assets; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Operates on 'ingested contents' and the backlog includes ingestion/upload (ZO-006); no missing complementary capability is clearly absent.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes user-provided tags via upload (ZO-006) and admin annotation (ZO-020); no obvious complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Depends on existence of 'Talk' comments and citizen annotations capture. The backlog lacks stories enabling volunteers to annotate/classify and to comment on Talk (creation of those inputs).

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Requires that annotations and Talk comments are produced/available. No complementary stories cover volunteer annotation/classification workflows or Talk commenting creation.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Identifying volunteer types presupposes volunteer accounts and activity/behavior data collection. The backlog lacks stories for volunteer onboarding/account management and capturing the necessary interaction data.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as an automated analysis over existing images; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing images; no missing complementary CRUD capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Analysis over existing image sets; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Automated preclassification can operate on existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Automated preclassification over existing images; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation of segmentation/localization itself; no complementary prerequisite is clearly missing.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Automated preclassification over existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Analysis over existing videos; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing videos; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features ... in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing satellite images; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Requires that volunteers can make classifications and that experience/history is captured. The backlog lacks complementary stories for volunteer classification workflows and tracking experience.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preprocessing over existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection over existing images; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio processing over existing audio files; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping can be performed over existing audio files; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Automated analysis over existing audio; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires an interaction mechanism with volunteers and monitoring of volunteer behavior/state to decide when to interrupt. Backlog lacks complementary stories for delivering interruptions and capturing the signals needed.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Presupposes the system can actually send interruptions/messages in those media. No complementary story exists for the messaging/notification delivery capability to volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer interaction monitoring and an education delivery mechanism. Backlog lacks complementary stories for capturing learning needs signals and delivering education content.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Requires capability to deliver educational content/messages to volunteers. No complementary story covers the underlying delivery/notification/presentation mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires a repository/catalog of education pieces and a way to assign/deliver them. Backlog lacks complementary stories to create/manage education content and deliver it to volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Depends on volunteers being able to make comments (Talk) and those comments being captured. Backlog lacks complementary stories enabling volunteer commenting/creating Talk comments.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Requires the capability for Zoonibot to post comments and for a comment system (Talk) to exist. No complementary story covers creating/posting comments by the bot or enabling the comment platform.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Presupposes a mechanism for Zoonibot to deliver explanations to volunteers (messaging/commenting). No complementary story exists for that delivery capability.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires that Zoonibot can actually communicate with volunteers (send/post messages). Backlog lacks complementary stories implementing the communication channel.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping 'subjects' presupposes subjects exist and are created/ingested/managed. The backlog lacks any story for creating/ingesting/managing Zooniverse 'subjects' (distinct from generic video upload).

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Requires tracking volunteer experience/history and having a defined set of projects to recommend. Backlog lacks complementary stories for capturing volunteer activity history and managing the project catalog for recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarizing/reusing 'articles' presupposes articles exist and can be created/ingested and stored. The backlog contains no complementary story for creating/importing/managing articles.
